criteria.evidence: server/tests/housekeeping-database.test.ts runs runHousekeeping against a freshly migrated PostgreSQL database seeded with rows on both sides of every retention cutoff plus audit_logs rows aged 400 and 3650 days and a backend_error_status_history row; after the pass both audit rows, the status history and the decided error remain, only the expired rows are gone, and a second pass deletes nothing. The housekeeping client type exposes no audit or status-history table. CI run 35560543452 on c5b786e, step 'Проверить сроки хранения и housekeeping T-090': 1 passed.

All retention periods and the run interval live in server/src/housekeeping/retention-policy.ts (RETENTION_POLICY); values without an owner decision are marked [ДОПУЩЕНИЕ]. server/tests/housekeeping.test.ts asserts every cutoff is derived from the policy passed in. Independent review verdict APPROVE on c5b786e confirms the criterion.

remaining: Owner question: approve a log event code (e.g. housekeeping.run, log/info, per-table counts only) for the info log that retention-and-pd.md §2 p.5 [ДОПУЩЕНИЕ] asks for; the approved events registry has none and the logger rejects unknown codes, so a successful pass is visible only as a completed job
Race: a staff status change on a backend error older than 90 days during the pass could be removed by cascade; low probability
The autosave pruning SQL compares a timestamp-without-time-zone column and is correct while the database session time zone is UTC (true in CI and on Neon)
With several API instances a duplicate housekeeping job is possible (check and enqueue are separate); the pass is idempotent; old rows of the jobs table are not pruned because no period is set
After a pass, re-clicking a used magic link logs reason 'unknown' instead of 'used'; the user response is the same NOT_FOUND
